tool_args.rationale: Acquire the trajectory batch to reach at least eight trajectories before fitting the four coupled-ODE parameters. Reconstruct the latent memory from each irregular prefix using relative time intervals; the pilot horizons already bracket the target horizon of 0.45.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five endpoint targets come from similarly timed histories and a narrow horizon range, leaving the coupling strength and memory timescale weakly separated.
The endpoint-matched history gap already favors the memory branch. The remaining uncertainty is within that branch, so additional trajectories are more useful than another branch test.
A snapshot model cannot explain different outcomes for matched endpoints with different histories.
